newsitem.title: USA: ARCO to settle notes with Lyondell stock.
newsitem.headline: ARCO to settle notes with Lyondell stock.

text.p: Atlantic Richfield Co on Monday said it intended to settle all its 9 percent exchangeable notes, due September 15, with its holdings of Lyondell Petrochemical Co stock.
"Our current intention to exchange out ARCO's equity interest in Lyondell is consistent with ARCO's priorities," Mike Bowlin, chief executive officer, said in a statement.
"While ARCO has enjoyed a successful relationship with Lyondell, we no longer consider Lyondell central to ARCO's core business or part of our strategic growth objectives," he said.

If there was no change in market conditions, ARCO would expect to realize a gain of more than $300 million upon the exchange of its shares of Lyondell stock. The decision to settle the notes with Lyondell shares can still be affected by a material change in market conditions, ARCO said.
ARCO currently owns 39.9 million shares, or about 49.9 percent of the total outstanding shares of Houston-based Lyondell.
